The Intelligent Rubrics-Based Evaluator is implemented in Python with a modular architecture for scalability. The front-end interface is built using the Streamlit web framework, while image submissions are processed through an OCR module to extract textual content from handwritten or digital inputs. After OCR and basic normalization, the extracted text and layout cues are fed into a deep learning pipeline for feature learning and rubric alignment.

For evaluation, a transformer-based deep learning model encodes the student response and each rubric criterion, then computes semantic alignment and logical structure consistency using attention mechanisms. The model outputs criterion-wise scores and confidence values, which are aggregated into the final rubric score and feedback. This deep learning approach captures contextual meaning, logical flow, and key algorithmic constructs more robustly than rule-only parsing.

The Intelligent Rubric-Based Evaluation System is a new type of assessment which automates the process of assessing student submissions by means of Artificial Intelligence and Predefined Evaluation Rubrics. This automated system is able to evaluate the submissions automatically for example flowcharts, algorithms, and written responses objectively, consistently, and in an organized manner.
The new Intelligent Rubric-Based Evaluation System integrates Optical Character Recognition (OCR), pre- trained transformer models associated with semantic reasoning
efficient automated assessment process. This reduction of manual evaluation effort will help eliminate human bias in the method of evaluation.

The Intelligent Rubric-Based Evaluation System allows for the automatic assessment of both image-based and text-based submissions, giving the ability to identify the features of a submission to perform an assessment against an established set of criteria based on each submitted rubric. Because the established criteria within a rubric create a level of order, fairness will exist when grading. In addition, the Intelligent Rubric-Based Evaluation System will allow for faster, more precise assessments using AI technology.
